environment.description: Same Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind internal ALB. PostgreSQL 15 Aurora cluster with IAM database authentication enabled. The application's task role resolves to database user 'inv_readonly_svc' via RDS IAM auth token generation. This database principal was provisioned through a Terraform module that applies pg_catalog-level row security and has explicit GRANT/REVOKE statements: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA inventory TO inv_readonly_svc; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA inventory FROM inv_readonly_svc; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA inventory REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES FROM inv_readonly_svc. The Aurora cluster parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and pgaudit extension logging DML. Note: the application code still compiles and deploys successfully - write operations will raise PSQLException at runtime with SQLSTATE 42501 (insufficient_privilege).

config.db_privileges: SELECT-only via explicit GRANT/REVOKE with DEFAULT PRIVILEGES revocation
config.network: Internal ALB, private subnets, Security Group allows only ALB ingress
config.iam_auth: RDS IAM authentication with task role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/ecs-inventory-task
